view.PreExposureNote: View.PreExposure = 0.00048828125 (1/2048) is the camera pre-exposure applied after the cache lookup at LumenScreenProbeTracing.usf:851; it is not the cache's CachedLightingPreExposure (1/16).

dispatch.dispatchNote: The pass binds both Div64 and Div32 indirect-arg triples; DumpGPU does not record which triple the dispatch consumed. The selected lane is below the allocator.

selection.rule: ascending compacted lane; uniform screen probe; valid scene depth; valid clipmap coverage; eight allocated neighbors; fractional weights in [0.05,0.95]; captured final TraceHit.bHit=false; non-zero replayed cache radiance; replayed depth matches captured TraceHit within 0.001 cm

directionalEncoding.formula: cell=(rayInfo&63,(rayInfo>>6)&63); level=(rayInfo>>12)&15; size=16>>level; uv=(cell+jitter)/size; direction=EqualAreaToSphere(uv); alpha=acosFast(1-1/size^2)

formulas.clipmapSelection: for level: q=(x-ClipmapCornerTWS)/CellSize; bottom=clip((q-0.5)*InvClipmapFadeSize,0,1); top=clip((Res-0.5-q)*InvClipmapFadeSize,0,1); first level with min(bottom,top)>0
formulas.grid: cellCoordinateFloat = (translatedWorldPosition - ClipmapCornerTWS)/CellSize (cell units); base=floor(cellCoordinateFloat-0.5); a=frac(cellCoordinateFloat-0.5). The raw (x-corner) values are cm.
formulas.bilinear: q=atlasUV*tileExtent-0.5; lo=floor(q); t=q-lo; four taps at lo+(0,0),(1,0),(0,1),(1,1)
formulas.combine: nested Z/Y/X lerp of eight neighborRadiance values with weights a
formulas.radianceScale: neighborRadiance = storedBilinear * RadianceCacheOneOverCachedLightingPreExposure * correction (un-pre-exposed); forwardModel = cacheRadiance * View.PreExposure (view-pre-exposed TraceRadiance space)

validity.probeWorldOffsetNote: all 16384 half4 offsets are zero in this captured version

radianceScale.storedTap: R11G11B10 word decoded to linear float; this is the cache-pre-exposed atlas value (linear radiance * CachedLightingPreExposure)
radianceScale.cachedLightingPreExposureNote: inverse of the captured RadianceCacheOneOverCachedLightingPreExposure=16.0; the cache atlas stores radiance*1/16
radianceScale.cacheRadiance: nested Z/Y/X lerp of the eight neighborRadiance values after the *16 cache-exposure inverse; un-pre-exposed cached-lighting radiance
radianceScale.forwardTraceRadianceModel: cacheRadiance * View.PreExposure; this is the view-pre-exposed TraceRadiance buffer space, not display-linear
radianceScale.note: cacheRadiance is un-pre-exposed cached-lighting radiance: the stored atlas is multiplied by RadianceCacheOneOverCachedLightingPreExposure (16) at LumenRadianceCacheInterpolation.ush:272, cancelling CachedLightingPreExposure. The consumer then multiplies by View.PreExposure at LumenScreenProbeTracing.usf:851 before storing TraceRadiance. Therefore forwardModel = cacheRadiance*View.PreExposure is view-pre-exposed scene-linear, not display-linear.

comparison.forwardModelSpace: view-pre-exposed scene-linear (after *View.PreExposure, matching LumenScreenProbeTracing.usf:851); cacheRadiance remains un-pre-exposed
comparison.boundary: cache-subtotal boundary; the preceding GDF/voxel result, skylight leaking, height fog and final R11G11B10 quantization are not asserted equal

coverageGaps: The exact compiled shader permutation is not recorded by DumpGPU; structured importance sampling is evidenced by captured CVars, the non-null ray-info binding and a valid packed RayInfo, not by a permutation bit.
NumGlobalSDFClipmaps is 0 in the captured view; the cache call is replayed, not the preceding voxel trace.
The GPU cache-only shader-local subtotal is not independently captured; the depth output is compared with the captured TraceHit word.
The selected query is reconstructed from captured compacted-trace state by a declared rule, not read from a per-thread shader register.
